question: What support coverage is committed for Redwood Private upgrades?
gold_answer: Redwood can staff the planned maintenance window with Redwood support and SRE escalation. A minimum of 48 hours notice is required, and a live bridge will be opened at the start of the window, maintaining coverage until completion or confirmed rollback.
answer_facts: The support commitment includes Redwood support and SRE escalation.
A minimum of 48 hours advance notice is required to schedule the support engagement.
Support involves opening a live bridge at the start of the maintenance window.
Coverage is maintained continuously until the upgrade completes or a rollback is confirmed.
